task.title: Leave a note at a place
task.shortdesc: Leave a message at a real spot for someone you matched with. They can open it only when they get there.

ul.li: You can leave a note only for someone you're matched or connected with.
Allow to use your location while you use the app. It uses your location only to place notes and to find notes left for you.

step.cmd: Tap Leave a note on the Notes tab or on the Match screen.
Under For, choose who the note is for.
In Where is it? A short hint, describe the spot.
step.info: Up to 40 characters, for example the lobby bar.

step.cmd: In Your message, write the note.
Under How close they need to be, choose a distance.
Under How long it stays, choose 1 day, 3 days, or 7 days.
step.info: For a match you haven't stayed connected with, this is a maximum: the note disappears when the match fades.

step.cmd: Turn on Only when I'm there too.

step.info: If your location reading is rough, the button reads Leave it anyway.

taskbody.result: They get a notification: name left you something, with your hint.
